description: The American Yawp is a free, college-level open textbook of United States history, written by hundreds of historians, that runs from the first peoples of the Americas to the present day. Each day your high schooler reads one or two sections online, narrates or writes about them, and often reads a matching document from the Yawp's free Primary Source Reader. It is openly licensed (CC BY-SA 4.0), so this plan is shared under the same ShareAlike license.
